thread:
lina: noticed a spike in SAST low-confidence hits this morning. many look like framework-generated code (templated routes). also missing KMS decrypt evidence on a subset. anyone else seeing this?

devon: yep, saw about ~140 alerts grouped into many tiny clusters. a lot of FP noise. we also got a DAST auth-fuzz alert that lacked audit context so triage was blocked.

priya: short note: yesterday's RBAC cleanup removed `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` from `scanner-sa` in prod-staging by accident. that's probably why evidence bundles are incomplete.

lina: ah okay. can we avoid re-firing all those findings while we restore evidence? we need a suppression/quiet window or change the alert routing.

devon: proposal: 1) add transient filter in alerting to suppress SAST findings with `confidence:low` for 6h OR until evidence enriched 2) flag findings missing `kms_audit_ref` -> route to a low-priority queue instead of PD 3) add watchlist rule to notify sec-eng when SA loses KMS decrypt perms

priya: agree. I'll push a scoped permission restore for scanner-sa for 30m while we backfill. command: 
```
# restore decrypt temporarily
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/scan-evidence-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
I'll also attach a brief note to the grant ticket with expiry and rollback instructions.

lina: can the scanner include the KMS call ids in the webhook payload? if triage UI can fetch the decrypt call it would speed up grouping.

devon: yes, we can add `kms_audit_refs: []` to the scan webhook. fallback logic: if empty then treat as untrusted evidence. also, modify grouping key to include KMS evidence id when present.

priya: backfill plan: export audit logs for the key ring for last 72h, map decrypt entries to artifact IDs, re-run enrichment job and re-group. I'll make a PR with a job and tests.

lina: for suppression, ops-bot can we create a temporary alert rule? only for `env:prod-staging` and `confidence:low` SAST rules that lack `kms_audit_refs`. 6h window.

ops-bot: created tactical suppressor: SUPP-2026-03-21-01. Scope: prod-staging, rule=(sast AND confidence:low AND NOT kms_audit_refs). Expires: 6h.

devon: on the watchlist side, add an automation: when a service account that is in `scanner-sa-group` loses KMS decrypt role, post a message to #eng-security and create a ticket. We want to catch RBAC flaps.

priya: i'll add the group and automation entries. also will add a small validator to the RBAC PR template that runs a preflight check: `check-kms-access scanner-sa`. sample check snippet: 
```
# preflight
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ... | grep scanner-sa || echo "MISSING"
```

lina: good. can we also suppress DAST auth-fuzz alerts that don't have an associated session token or auth headers in evidence? those are almost always noise from the fuzzer.

devon: i'll add that to the webhook transform: if evidence.http.headers has no Authorization and no session cookie, mark as `auto_suppress:true` unless `risk:high`.

scanner-bot: scan webhook: id=scan-2026-03-21-0912, sast_low=82, sast_med=4, dast_auth_fuzz=1, kms_audit_refs=[]

lina: thanks. next actions recap: priya restores scoped decrypt for 30m + backfill job PR; devon updates webhook + grouping + suppress rules; ops-bot created SUPP-2026-03-21-01; lina will add note to security runbook with the RBAC preflight snippet and suppression policy. owners: priya (evidence backfill), devon (webhook + grouping), lina (runbook + follow-up).

priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood/sec-scan/pull/399 - backfill + preflight check. includes mapping script and unit tests.

devon: opened change: https://github.com/redwood/scan-proxy/pull/212 - adds `kms_audit_refs` and auto_suppress heuristics.

lina: i'll monitor for 24h and then close suppression early if noise drops below threshold. setting alert threshold to 5 new low-confidence clusters/hour for 24h.

(reacts: priya :white_check_mark:, devon :rocket:, lina :eyes:)
